predictions.selection_reason: root path -> normalize -> ensures consistent path traversal check comparison
predictions.source_summary: root comes from options.root constructor parameter, resolved via path.resolve() at initialization. When root is set via options.from or deprecated root() method, it's also resolved. Source is application-controlled configuration.
predictions.sink_summary: Normalized root is used in path traversal security check at line 412: path.substr(0, root.length) !== root triggers 403 error if path doesn't start with root. Also used to extract relative parts for dotfile handling.
predictions.guard_summary: Path traversal protection: compares normalized path against normalized root. If mismatch, returns 403 error. Also has null byte check, '..' path check when root is null, and dotfile access controls.
predictions.risk_pattern: Normalization ensures consistent path comparison for security boundary enforcement. Without normalization, inconsistent path representations could bypass root directory restriction.
predictions.context_summary: Added normalization of root path to match the normalization of the joined path, ensuring consistent comparison for security boundary check that prevents directory traversal outside root.
unresolved_facts: Specific callers and validation of options.root parameter
Whether options.root can be influenced by untrusted input in typical usage
